name: North Star Scientific Corporation
old_description: At North Star Scientific Corporation, we design, develop, test, qualify, and manufacture reliable, high performance electronics for land-based, ship-based, and airborne DOD applications. We specialize in RF system designs and rapid R&D/custom solutions. While NSS continues to rapidly grow our list of innovative products, the most valuable asset we have built is our name. Above all, customer satisfaction is what we strive for through quality products, excellent pricing, responsive service, and by going the extra mile. We are proud to provide our services to the United States Military and commercial clients alike.
about:
North Star Scientific Corporation is based in Kapolei, Hawaii. The company designs, develops, tests, qualifies, and manufactures high-performance electronics for defense and commercial markets. No founding year or founders are disclosed in public sources.

The firm specializes in RF system designs and rapid R&D and custom solutions, incorporating analog and digital disciplines along with FPGA and microprocessor technologies. Its capabilities span the full product lifecycle from design through qualification and manufacture, though facility size, headcount, and production volumes are not published.

North Star serves land-based, ship-based, and airborne Department of Defense applications, as well as commercial clients. Its customer base includes the United States Military and various commercial entities, though specific programs or partners are not named.

The company states that its most valuable asset is its reputation, built on customer satisfaction through quality products, competitive pricing, responsive service, and going the extra mile. It maintains AS9100D and ISO 9001:2015 certification as evidence of its quality commitment.
